description: This file defines the main React component for a notes application frontend, handling state management, CRUD operations via API calls, and rendering UI elements including forms and modals.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form state, clearing editing note, title, and content.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Opens the form modal in create mode, resetting the form.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the form modal in edit mode with the selected note loaded.

methods.name: closeForm
methods.description: Closes the form modal and resets form state.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the backend API.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the note form data, checking for required and length constraints.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating notes with optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: requestDelete
methods.description: Initiates the delete confirmation process for a note.

methods.name: confirmDeleteNow
methods.description: Performs the deletion of a note with optimistic UI update and rollback on failure.
